{{Quote|Remember this day, the day Onderon became free again!|King Ramsis Dendup|<ref name="Tipping Points">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>}}
A '''funeral''' was held for [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], the leader of the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]], following her [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]] of [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. Thousands of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]] citizens attended the event, with [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] leading the ceremony.
